details: Finding good training hyperparameters. At scale, exhaustive sweeps are impossible, so techniques like muP parameterize networks so optimal hyperparameters transfer from small proxy models to large ones.

explainer.lead: muP is a technique for finding good training hyperparameters at scale, where exhaustive sweeps are impossible. It matters because it lets optimal settings transfer from small proxy models to large ones.

tiers.eli5: Like fine-tuning a small model car to learn the settings that will also make the full-size car run well.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers parameterize networks so hyperparameters tuned on small proxy models carry over to large models, avoiding full-scale searches. The pitfall is assuming the transfer holds without checking on the target scale.
tiers.paperLevel: muP parameterizes networks so optimal hyperparameters transfer from small proxy models to large ones. It addresses the limit that exhaustive sweeps are impossible at scale.

explainer.example: Tune the learning rate on a small proxy model built with muP parameterization, then apply that value to the much larger model instead of sweeping at full scale.
